name: Solar Flare Phoenix Nesting on a Mountain of Light
description: A massive mountain made of pure light where a magnificent phoenix with solar flames nests, its feathers ablaze with colors of sunrise, ash falling like glitter, surrounding valley mirrored in a lake.
prompt: Enormous mountain composed of luminous crystalline light, phoenix with solar-flame feathers perched on summit, flames swirling in golden-orange hues, ash descending like sparkling glitter, lake at base reflecting the scene, dawn sky, epic fantasy, ultra-detailed, radiant.
caption: The phoenix rises from a mountain of light 🔥✨ Let its solar flames warm your soul.
